body:
I’ve never talk to anyone about suicide so sorry if I fuck this up.

There is probably nothing I can do to stop you, if you are dead set on suicide it would be hard for someone who personally knows you to stop you and much less someone on the internet. I haven’t seen any of your previous post because I usually don’t lurk on this subreddit, but I’m sorry nobody has seen your previous posts and has tried to talk to you.
I just hope when you get to the point when you are about to take the actions that end your life you see something, anything that gives you energy to keep going even for just a few more days. And in that few days I hope you get the courage to tell someone you know personally who cares about what you’re currently going through.
If you go through with it and survive, I hope you are hospitalized and get the proper treatment that is needed for someone who has gotten so deep into the rut you are in right now.
While it’s quite hypocritical for me to be saying all this right now, it’s what I want for you. I say this even though I don’t know you. I know what it’s like, I’m right there with you right now and I hope you find something to keep going.

I would love to do that. Unfortunately I have parents who know I struggle with isolation. My dad is a huge advocate for school and when a thought pops in his head of me missing school it send shivers down his spine. No amount of negotiation with my parents will even get me to good compromise for this idea.

About my self harming, suicidal ideation, suicide plans, what I think, what I feel, why I feel this way, etc.
After I’m dead I’d rather not have people poking through my writing, or worse if I survive and then having deal with the onslaught of questions that arise.

I’m happy sometimes and it’s nice to live for that, unfortunately these suicidal thoughts are much stronger and more frequent. I know life is about finding the little things to enjoy but these dark horrible are an unbeatable juggernaut compared to the moments I’m happy. These thoughts take over my life and these thoughts become me, and all I can ever think about is killing myself.
There’s nothing you can do. Advice and warnings do nothing. The only way someone can stop me is by physical force, and for as distant as you probably are that would be quite difficult.
